name: neexy-wizard-video
description: Video tutorial del wizard de Neexy — reemplaza el texto de los pasos de onboarding

scripts.durations: for f in public/voiceover/*.mp3; do printf '%s: %ss\n' "$(basename $f)" "$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 $f)"; done
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts WizardVideo out/neexy-wizard.mp4 --codec h264 --quality 85
